name: DependencyObjects
description: Represents the collection of AccessObject objects that a DependencyInfo object contains.
remarks: To return a DependencyObjects collection, use the Dependants or Dependencies property of the DependencyInfo object. To return a single AccessObject object, use the Item property of the DependencyObjects collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Use the Application property to access the active Microsoft Access Application object and its related properties. Read-only Application object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: The Item property returns a specific member of a collection either by position or by index. Read-only AccessObject.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Use the Count property to determine the number of items in a specified collection. Read-only Long.
